(Nasdaq: OPNW) ('OpenWorld” or the 'Company”), a blockchain innovation company advancing real-world asset tokenization, today announced that its common stock is now available on Solana as tokenized OPNW. news.title: Commission Mutual Fund Platform "Pucho 5paisa AI Se"
news.description: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], November 5: 5paisa Capital Limited, one of India's leading digital financial services platforms, today announced the launch of its upgraded mutual fund investing platform. It combines zero-commission Direct Plans with free research tools and 'Pucho 5paisa AI Se,' an AI assistant built and owned by 5paisa.
